Harper: Heads-up: sudden increase in mTLS handshake failures for services in eu-north-1 at ~14:12 UTC. Logs show KMS Decrypt AccessDenied during cert unwrap.
Leila: Saw that. Example from proxy: `unwrap error: KMS:AccessDeniedException Decrypt denied for arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/proxy-keystore`
Marco: I rolled an RBAC tightening to the shared key yesterday to add a `kms:EncryptionContext` requirement (service=extractor). It should've been scoped to the extractor key only.
Jin: If the shared key now requires an EncryptionContext, any decrypt without that context (proxies) will be denied. That matches the timing.
sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-5077 created and assigned to eng-security.
Harper: Mitigation options: (1) revert the key policy change (fast), (2) enable operator-only short keystore cache (risky), (3) route proxies to a regional fallback key (slow). Thoughts?
Leila: Revert + small operator cache window seems safest. We intentionally turned cache-on-deny off, but a 3-5 minute operator-controlled window with alerting is OK as a temporary safety valve.
Marco: Rolling back now. Change id rb-5077-2. I'll post when applied.
Jin: Parallel followups: add deploy-time policy-emulator step in the IAM pipeline that simulates Decrypt for critical assumed-role ARNs and verifies EncryptionContext requirements won't deny proxies; and add an IAM rollout metric `iam.kms.policy.rollout{change_id}`.
Leila: Also propose we make proxies always attach EncryptionContext keys `service=proxy` and `route_id` on Decrypt calls. That way CloudTrail will show requestParameters and denies are easier to map.
sec-bot: Policy revert rb-5077-2 applied at 14:16:38 UTC.
Harper: Post-revert checks: decrypt success rate climbing, TLS handshakes recovering in eu-north-1. Monitoring 45m.
Marco: Sorry team, misapplied the extractor-only policy to the shared key. Will add a checklist: (a) identify affected keys, (b) run policy emulator against a matrix of assumed-roles/egress paths, (c) notify eng-security prior to apply.
Jin: I'll open PRs for: TOOLING-1301 (policy emulator), INFRA-3400 (keystore operator cache flag + alert on fallback), and ENGSEC-4901 (postmortem + telemetry work). Also add a CI lint rule to flag EncryptionContext policy additions affecting shared keys.
Leila: Runbook update suggestions: add CloudTrail query snippet for quick deny lookups and a step to check `keystore_cache_fallback` metric. Example quick query: `fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, errorMessage | filter eventName = "Decrypt" and errorMessage like /AccessDenied/ | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50`.
Harper: Good. Once alerts quiet down, let's schedule a 30-minute postmortem to capture the timeline and assign follow-ups. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
